_what: How Trillion HQ hears from every customer, as DATA (src/tell-us.mjs, src/journey.mjs, src/customers-hq.mjs). `kinds` are the four things a report can be, the same whether a person sends it from the sidebar's Tell us screen or their AI sends it with the tell_trillions_makers tool: `id` is what the tool takes, `label` is what the Notes from members list keeps (and the sidebar kind choice). `sent_by` says which road a report came by (`ai` or `screen`); `harness` is the AI app that sent it. `journey` is what the per-customer timeline keeps: it is one row per thing a customer did (account, at, surface, kind, label, facts) in a separate `journeys-<n>` instance of the interaction log, `shards` of them, swept after `keep_days`. `recorded` names the kinds of event kept and which of their facts; a fact not named here is never kept, and `words` (free text) are kept only when the account's `content` choice is on (records/hq-sharing.json). `struggling` is when a customer is flagged: `at_least` events from `trouble` in the last `days` (a trouble row is an event kind, and for a report the kinds that count).

words.said: Sent to the people who make Trillion. Thank you.
words.no_note: Say what happened in a short note.
words.bad_kind: kind must be one of bug, friction, idea or feedback.
words.not_sharing: This account does not share its activity with Trillion HQ, so nothing was sent. Carry on.

screen.heading: Customers
screen.lead: Reports from every customer's AI and from the Tell us screen, grouped, then each customer's recent journey. Customers who are struggling come first.
